lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr₂Pd₄P₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 1), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pd centers with 9 geometric neighbors (1 P, 8 Pr) and Pr centers with 14 neighbors (8 P, 6 Pd), while P adopts a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with 8 Pd neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between P 8-vertex polyhedra and between Pd 9-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and face-sharing also observed between Pd and Pr polyhedra.
